# Implementation Plan: happy-cli test-baseline failures cleanup

<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"happy-cli-test-baseline-failures-cleanup"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-27. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`.*
*Target repo for the implementation: **codexu primary** (`D:/harness-efforts/codexu`), package `packages/happy-cli`. Single repo, no submodules. (The repo-root `environments/environments.ts` is referenced read-only; per Phase-4 review it is NOT edited — see Approach.)*

## Overview

`pnpm --filter happy test` (which runs `tsc --noEmit && pkgroll && vitest run` across 6
vitest projects) currently fails on `main`: **19 test files / 59 tests failed** (1092
passed, 12 skipped, 1163 total). The build/typecheck step PASSES — these are pure test
failures. The failures collapse into a small number of root-cause clusters, and **43 of
the ~49 test-level failures come from just 3 unit files**. This plan triages every cluster,
fixes the straightforward deterministic ones, and removes the environment-dependent
integration projects from the default gate (config-level opt-in, documented), so that
`pnpm --filter happy test` becomes a trustworthy green acceptance gate for future happy-cli
implementations.

Today the full suite is **not enforced by CI** (CI only builds, packs, and binary-smoke-tests
the CLI), so "trustworthy gate" here means a reliable **local/dev** acceptance signal.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

- Test command: `package.json` → `"test": "pnpm run build && vitest run"`. On Windows run as
  `npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm --filter happy test` (AGENTS.md L39) so `$npm_execpath`
  expands; for file-scoped runs use `pnpm --filter happy exec vitest run <paths>` (AGENTS.md L40).
- `packages/happy-cli/vitest.config.ts` defines 6 projects: `unit` (`src/**/*.test.ts` excl.
  `*.integration.test.ts`, default 5000ms `testTimeout`), `integration-empty`,
  `integration-claude-utils`, `integration-plan-mode`, `integration-authenticated`,
  `integration-agent-comms`. `pnpm --filter happy test` runs **all 6**.
- globalSetup `src/test-setup.ts` builds the CLI and sets `HAPPY_RUN_SANDBOX_NETWORK_TESTS=1`.
- **Integration provisioning is the hard-fail surface, and it cannot be rescued by per-test
  `skipIf` (confirmed by all 3 Phase-4 reviewers).** `integration.setup.empty.ts`
  (`template:'empty', up:false`) and `integration.setup.authenticated.ts`
  (`template:'authenticated-empty', up:true`) `await installIntegrationEnvironment` at module
  scope → `src/testing/integrationEnvironment.ts:45` → root `environments/environments.ts`
  migration throw. Even if that setup were made graceful, integration test files read the env at
  **module top-level**: `src/testing/currentIntegrationEnv.ts:8-13` `getIntegrationEnv()` THROWS
  `'No active integration environment'` when unset, and e.g. `daemon.integration.test.ts:57`
  calls it at top level. Further, `daemon.integration.test.ts:244`
  `describe('Daemon Fan-Out Integration', …)` has **no** `skipIf` gate, so a graceful setup would
  make it RUN and ERROR in its own `beforeAll`, not skip. Therefore setup-boundary gating alone is
  not viable; project-level gating is.
- The team already uses `skipIf` as the gating idiom: `describe.skipIf(!claudeAvailable)`
  (`claude.integration.test.ts:257`), `!claudeInstalled` (`claudeLocalLauncher.integration.test.ts:39`),
  `!codexAppServerAvailable` + `RUN_CODEX_INTEGRATION` (`codex.integration.test.ts:74,244`),
  `!gatewayAvailable` (`openclaw.integration.test.ts:102…`), `RUN_CLAUDE_INTEGRATION!=='1'`
  (`queryInitMetadata.integration.test.ts:13`), `!RUN_NETWORK_INTEGRATION`
  (`network.integration.test.ts:19`), `process.platform==='win32'` (`claudeLocal.test.ts:251`).
  Unconditional-quarantine precedent: `daemon.integration.test.ts:708`
  `it.skip('[skipped] should detect version mismatch …')`. There is **no** issue-link skip
  convention today.
- **CI does NOT run vitest.** `.github/workflows/cli-smoke-test.yml` only does
  `pnpm --filter happy build` + `pack` + binary smoke (`happy --help/--version/doctor/daemon
  status`). `typecheck.yml` is happy-app only. So the full suite is **purely a local/dev
  acceptance signal today**; the integration projects (which need real auth/DB/agent binaries)
  were never a reliable gate.
- Inventory: 144 unit `*.test.ts` files (~1095 cases); 10 `*.integration.test.ts` files (~39 cases).

### Empirical baseline + root-cause clusters

Captured once (`happy-cli-test-baseline.out`, saved in the session files dir) from the
primary checkout on `origin/main` @ 56953d95.

> **LOAD CAVEAT (load-bearing).** The capture ran under heavy concurrent crew-member load
> (vitest reported transform 158s / collect 394s / prepare 489s — abnormally high). The
> **timeout cluster (C)** and the **integration-migration cluster (D)** are therefore SUSPECT
> as load artifacts (5000ms default timeout blown; migration subprocess killed → `status null`).
> Clusters A, B, E, F are deterministic and load-independent. NOTE (per reviewer): `status null`
> from the migrate subprocess is at least as consistent with a missing DB/toolchain prerequisite
> as with a load-kill — Story 0 must treat a *persisting* isolated D-failure as confirmation of a
> real prerequisite gap, not load.

| Cluster | Count | File(s) | Root cause | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | 29 | `runClaude.test.ts` (14), `runClaudePublishMode.test.ts` (15) | `vi.hoisted` `mockSession` double lacks `setLedgerIdleReachedHandler`; prod `runClaude.ts:724` calls it (defined for real at `session.ts:163`). | **FIX** |
| **B-apiSession** | 14 | `api/apiSession.test.ts` | all in `describe('ApiSessionClient v3 messages API migration')` (`apiSession.test.ts:215`); e.g. `queues agent configuration metadata diffs…` (`:270`) → `expected [] to deeply equal [{model:'claude-opus',…}]`. | **FIX (investigate for real regression)** |
| **C** | 14 | 10 files, 1–3 each | `Test timed out in 5000ms` (unit default). Spread thin → load-induced suspicion. | **VERIFY-IN-ISOLATION → fix/document** |
| **D** | 6 (file-level) | 6 integration files | `Migration failed with exit code null` @ `environments/environments.ts:357` → project-wide setup hard-fail; compounded by module-load `getIntegrationEnv()` throws + ungated Fan-Out block. | **GATE AT PROJECT LEVEL (opt-in)** |
| **B-sessionScanner** | 1 | `claude/utils/sessionScanner.test.ts` | `expected length 3 but got 2` (dedup). | **FIX (investigate for real regression)** |
| **B-codexCommand** | 1 | `commands/codexCommand.test.ts` | 1 assertion (+2 timeouts in C). | **FIX (investigate for real regression)** |
| **E** | 1 | `ledger/writer.test.ts` | `ENOTEMPTY/EBUSY` temp-dir cleanup race (documented Windows `fs.watch` race). | **FIX** (AGENTS.md L41 remedy) |
| **F** | 1 | `api/apiSession.test.ts` | `Error: bad nonce size` (TweetNaCl). | **FIX** |
| **G** | 1 | `agentComms/scopeB.test.ts` | `afterAll → server.stop()` on undefined `server`; cascade of scopeB's `beforeAll` timeout (same root as its C entry). scopeB is the only `fs.watch` user. | **FIX with C** |

### Technical Constraints

- `setLedgerIdleReachedHandler` exists in production (`session.ts:163`) and is a real class-field
  arrow method, so the fix is to update the **test doubles**, not production. Each of
  `runClaude.test.ts` and `runClaudePublishMode.test.ts` defines its OWN hoisted `mockSession`,
  so the fix lands in both files.
- The integration hard-fail (D) happens at module/setup load and is unreachable by `describe.skipIf`
  (see Codebase Context). Gating must be at the **vitest project level** (do not run the integration
  projects in the default gate unless an opt-in env flag is set). This requires **no edits to
  integration test content** and leaves the repo-root `environments/environments.ts` untouched.
- Bucket-C timing tests assert real product logic; the flakiness is environmental. Prefer
  determinism fixes (raised `testTimeout`, fake timers, `fs.rm(...,{recursive,force,maxRetries,
  retryDelay})` per AGENTS.md L41, pick-free-port retry, partial `child_process` mock per
  AGENTS.md L42) over blanket `.skip` — over-quarantining collapses the gate to Bucket A.

## Approach

### Architecture

Triage-then-resolve, cluster by cluster, with a mandatory **isolated re-baseline first** to
separate genuine failures from load artifacts. Deterministic clusters (A, B, E, F, the small
unit ones) are fixed outright — and where a failing assertion might reflect a real product
regression (cluster B: apiSession v3-migration, sessionScanner dedup, codexCommand), the impl
records a one-line test-drift-vs-product-fix verdict rather than blindly greening the assertion.
Timing cluster (C/G) is verified in isolation, then fixed deterministically where cheap or
`skipIf`-gated (with concrete evidence) where genuinely environment/timing-bound.

The integration cluster (D) is resolved with **Option B — config-level project gating**, the
approach all three Phase-4 reviewers converged on (Option A "graceful setup skip" is
unimplementable without editing integration test content, including the ungated
`daemon.integration.test.ts:244` Fan-Out block). Concretely, `packages/happy-cli/vitest.config.ts`
builds its `projects` array conditionally: the `unit` project is always included; the five
integration projects are included **only when `process.env.RUN_INTEGRATION === '1'`** (developers
/ CI with real prerequisites opt in). Existing per-test `skipIf` gates continue to skip within the
integration projects when a binary/auth is partially present.

**The acceptance signal is therefore: default `pnpm --filter happy test` runs the deterministic
`unit` gate and exits 0; the integration projects are an opt-in, documented "tracked skip" run via
`RUN_INTEGRATION=1`.** This satisfies the task's permitted "documented, small, tracked skip-list",
is more trustworthy than a flaky full-suite, mirrors CI reality (CI never runs vitest), and is the
natural base for a later split-CI gate (required unit job + optional integration job).

### Implementation Strategy

1. **Story 0 (re-baseline, do FIRST, its own phase).** On an unloaded box, capture a clean
   `npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm --filter happy test` run to a named file and produce a
   machine-readable before-list of failing/skipped tests. Confirm A/B/E/F persist; record whether
   cluster-C timeouts and the cluster-D migration `exit code null` still occur unloaded (a persisting
   D-failure confirms a real prerequisite gap, not load). Every other story depends on Story 0.
2. **Deterministic unit fixes (A; B-apiSession+F; small unit + E)** — independent files, parallel-safe.
3. **Timing cluster (C/G)** — raise `testTimeout` and/or make deterministic; `skipIf`-gate any
   genuinely environment/timing-bound remainder with concrete evidence.
4. **Integration project gating (D)** — config-level in `vitest.config.ts`: integration projects
   included only when `RUN_INTEGRATION=1`. No test-content edits; no `environments.ts` edit.
5. **Acceptance + documentation closeout** — full green default run + AGENTS.md skip-list / opt-in
   doc + `// TODO(<ref>):` on any new `skipIf`; final verification against the Story-0 before-list.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Triaging and resolving the 19-file / 59-test baseline failure set so the default
  `pnpm --filter happy test` (the `unit` gate) exits 0 on the dev box.
- Fixing deterministic test-double / assertion / cleanup-race failures (clusters A, B, E, F, small unit).
- Resolving cluster-C timeouts deterministically or `skipIf`-gating with evidence.
- Config-level gating of the integration projects behind `RUN_INTEGRATION=1` (cluster D).
- A small, documented, tracked skip-list / opt-in note in `packages/happy-cli/AGENTS.md`.

### Out of Scope
- Adding a CI workflow that runs vitest (noted as a follow-up; CI currently only smoke-tests).
  The split-CI gate (required unit job + optional integration job) is documented as the upgrade path.
- **Editing integration test content** (sentinel-env accessors, per-suite `skipIf` inside the
  integration files, the ungated Fan-Out block). Option B (project-level gating) deliberately avoids
  this; if the operator later wants the integration projects to skip *cleanly when run with
  `RUN_INTEGRATION=1` but no DB*, that graceful-degradation work is a separate follow-up.
- Editing the repo-root `environments/environments.ts` (shared by other consumers) — unless Story 0
  confirms a genuine, in-scope migration bug, in which case surface it to the lead before editing.
- Refactoring production behavior beyond what a failing test legitimately exposes.

## Risk Areas
- **Masking real regressions.** Cluster B (apiSession v3-migration, sessionScanner dedup,
  codexCommand) could reflect a real production behavior change, not test drift. The impl MUST read
  the production code and record a drift-vs-product verdict per sub-cluster; do not blanket-rewrite
  assertions to green (AC3/AC4 enforce this).
- **Over-quarantining.** Blanket-skipping cluster-C timing tests hides real daemon/codex/agentComms
  logic. Keep skips prerequisite-conditional, evidence-backed, and small; never skip a Bucket-A
  pure-unit test.
- **Lowering the gate too far.** Option B moves the integration projects out of the default run. This
  is acceptable (they need external prereqs and were never stable), but the unit gate must stay
  comprehensive — verify the default run still includes ALL `unit` tests and that gating did not
  accidentally drop unit coverage.
- **Load-confounded triage.** Skipping Story 0 (isolated re-baseline) risks "fixing" timeouts that
  were only load artifacts (and vice-versa). Story 0 is mandatory and produces the before-list AC9
  compares against.
- **vitest.config.ts single-owner.** Both the `testTimeout` raise and the integration project gating
  edit `vitest.config.ts`; they are bundled into one serialized story to avoid a merge conflict.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **AC1 (re-baseline + before-list).** On an unloaded box, `npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm
  --filter happy test` is captured to
  `.ralph/jobs/happy-cli-test-baseline-failures-cleanup/isolated-baseline.out`, and a machine-readable
  before-list of failing+skipped test ids is written to
  `.ralph/jobs/happy-cli-test-baseline-failures-cleanup/rebaseline-clusters.md` (cluster → file →
  count). The note explicitly states whether cluster C and cluster D persisted unloaded; a persisting
  D-failure is recorded as a confirmed prerequisite gap (not load). No source is modified in this story.
- [ ] **AC2 (cluster A).** `pnpm --filter happy exec vitest run src/claude/runClaude.test.ts
  src/claude/runClaudePublishMode.test.ts` is green (29 previously-failing cases pass); the fix adds
  the missing method(s) to the test doubles, not production.
- [ ] **AC3 (cluster B-apiSession + F).** `apiSession.test.ts` is green; the v3-migration describe
  block and the bad-nonce test pass. A drift-vs-product verdict for each sub-cluster is recorded in
  `.ralph/jobs/happy-cli-test-baseline-failures-cleanup/apiSession-triage.md`. If a failure reflects a
  real product regression, the product code is fixed (not the assertion).
- [ ] **AC4 (small deterministic + masking safeguard).** `sessionScanner.test.ts`,
  `codexCommand.test.ts`, and `ledger/writer.test.ts` are green; the writer fix uses
  `fs.rm(...,{recursive,force,maxRetries,retryDelay})` per AGENTS.md L41. For `sessionScanner`
  (length 3 vs 2) and the `codexCommand` assertion, a one-line drift-vs-product verdict is recorded
  (same safeguard as AC3) so a real cluster-B regression cannot be silently greened.
- [ ] **AC5 (cluster C/G, evidence-backed).** Every cluster-C/scopeB test either passes in isolation,
  is fixed deterministically (raised `testTimeout` / fake timers / retry), or — only with concrete
  evidence (the isolated-run output showing the timeout, a stated reason a deterministic fix is
  impractical, and the exact `skipIf` condition) — is `skipIf`-gated with a skip-list row. No
  Bucket-A pure-unit test is blanket-skipped.
- [ ] **AC6 (cluster D, project gating — concrete).** `packages/happy-cli/vitest.config.ts` includes
  the five integration projects only when `process.env.RUN_INTEGRATION === '1'`. Verified by: (a)
  default `pnpm --filter happy test` runs only the `unit` project (integration projects absent from
  the run, not errored) and exits 0; (b) `RUN_INTEGRATION=1 npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm
  --filter happy test` still includes the integration projects (so the gate is opt-in, not deleted).
  No integration test file is edited.
- [ ] **AC7 (acceptance gate, unloaded).** On an unloaded box (same condition as AC1),
  `npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm --filter happy test` exits 0 with `tsc --noEmit` passing.
- [ ] **AC8 (documented skip-list, capped).** A `### Test skip-list / quarantine` subsection exists in
  `packages/happy-cli/AGENTS.md` (Testing block) documenting (i) the integration opt-in
  (`RUN_INTEGRATION=1`) and (ii) a table of any unit-level `skipIf` quarantines (file · condition ·
  tracking ref · re-enable prereq). Each new unit code skip carries a matching `// TODO(<ref>):`
  comment. The number of unit-level quarantine skips added by this task is **≤ 5** and equals the
  number of rows in the table; no Bucket-A pure-unit test appears in it.
- [ ] **AC9 (no regressions, count-compared).** The final default-run failing-count is 0 and the
  skipped set is compared against the AC1 before-list: every newly-skipped test is accounted for in
  the AC8 table, and no previously-passing test became failing or silently skipped. `tsc --noEmit`
  still passes.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

- **US-000** (Phase 0, mandatory first) Re-baseline in isolation + before-list.
- **US-001** Fix cluster A — `setLedgerIdleReachedHandler` in the two runClaude mocks (29).
- **US-002** Fix `apiSession.test.ts` — v3-migration block (14) + bad nonce (1) + its timeout (1) + verdict.
- **US-003** Fix small deterministic unit — sessionScanner (1, +verdict), codexCommand (1+2, +verdict), ledger/writer E (1)+timeouts (2).
- **US-004** Resolve timeout cluster C + scopeB G; owns `vitest.config.ts` `testTimeout`.
- **US-005** Gate integration projects behind `RUN_INTEGRATION=1`; **also edits `vitest.config.ts`** → bundled/serialized with US-004.

## Open Questions
- **Acceptance-signal shape (Option B vs full-suite-green).** This plan adopts Option B
  (config-gated integration, opt-in via `RUN_INTEGRATION=1`) on the unanimous Phase-4 reviewer
  recommendation, because Option A (truly-full-suite-green) requires editing integration test content
  including the ungated `daemon.integration.test.ts:244` Fan-Out block. `[INFERRED]` default: Option B.
  If the operator requires the *integration projects themselves* to be green-or-clean-skip on a
  no-prereq box, that is the heavier Option-A follow-up (sentinel env in `currentIntegrationEnv.ts` +
  per-suite `skipIf` on an `available` flag) — surface for an explicit decision.
- **Tracking-ref form for quarantine skips.** No issue-link skip convention exists today. Recommend a
  short descriptive marker (e.g. `// TODO(test-baseline): …`) for env-gated `skipIf` and a GitHub
  issue (`slopus/happy`) or codexu overview follow-up id for any unconditional quarantine.
  `[INFERRED]` — bookkeeper/operator to confirm the preferred ref form.
- **Default `testTimeout` raise vs per-test.** Resolved by US-000: prefer per-test timeouts/determinism;
  raise the global `unit` `testTimeout` only if the isolated re-baseline shows broad load-sensitivity.
